en: A multiview color postcard with a magenta background featuring five photographs of landmarks from the city of Pécs. The images include the exterior and interior of a large cathedral, ruins seen through an arched stone gate, a building complex on a wooded hillside, and a central square with a domed former mosque, a tall column, and an equestrian statue surrounded by parked vintage cars. The word "PÉCS" is printed in bold capital letters on the front. The reverse side contains Hungarian handwritten text, a Pécs postmark dated 1971, a red MAGYAR POSTA stamp, and printed publisher information in Hungarian.
